findings.why_it_matters: The specific quip and the 'office-dwellers' collective noun do mild but real register work, grounding the narrator in workplace-comedy voice before she steps out alone; the draft collapses this to 'Laughter, office quips.'
findings.suggested_fix: Restore the 'I'm just seeing my eyelids' line and the 'office-dwellers' phrase; one sentence covers it.

findings.source_passage: The front doors spilled out onto a major intersection, and all around me bustled a humanity eager to get home to family and dinner. I only had the dinner part, but pizza awaited me.
findings.why_it_matters: The 'family and dinner / I only had the dinner part' contrast is the story's first self-deprecating beat; the draft keeps the pizza line but loses the contrasting setup, softening the lonely-single-woman characterisation.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore the 'family and dinner — I only had the dinner part' contrast before the pizza line.

findings.source_passage: She's on to me." Heather blinked at him. "On to you?" He shook his head. "It's nothing.
findings.why_it_matters: Blake's cryptic 'She's on to me / It's nothing' exchange is the chapter's first paranormal hint and a small interpretive keystone for the dragon-pursuit plot; the draft omits Heather's confused follow-up and Blake's deflection entirely.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore Heather's 'On to you?' and Blake's 'It's nothing' — three lines that cost almost no word-count.

findings.source_passage: I glanced at Blake's retreating back and pursed my lips. "Then stop trying to help me. The guys you keep showing me are getting creepier."
findings.why_it_matters: Miriam watching Blake's retreating back while delivering the 'creepier' line is a small but deliberate ironic beat; the draft keeps the dialogue but drops the stage direction, flattening the dry-observation register.
findings.suggested_fix: Add the glance at Blake's retreating back before the 'creepier' line.

summary: No high-severity signature losses; four low-severity flattenings (the office-dwellers quip, the family/dinner contrast, Blake's cryptic deflection, and the retreating-back stage direction) mildly thin the opening voice and one small interpretive beat, but none individually or collectively triggers regeneration.
